mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_audit_log ( audit_id, occurred_at, actor_kind, actor_principal_id, actor_client_id, action_code, target_type, target_id, outcome, reason_code, request_id, correlation_id, source_ip, details ) VALUES ( #{auditId}, COALESCE(#{occurredAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{actorKind}, #{actorPrincipalId}, #{actorClientId}, #{actionCode}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{outcome}, #{reasonCode}, #{requestId}, #{correlationId}, NULLIF(#{sourceIp}, '')::inet, COALESCE(#{details}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM identity_audit_log WHERE actor_principal_id = #{actorPrincipalId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
SELECT * FROM identity_audit_log WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
